_comment: Date-stamped price sheet. Every historical cost number is only meaningful
against a known price sheet, so this file is versioned and never inlined
into the script. To reprice history against a different date, copy this
Cache multipliers relative to the model's input rate (verified against
Anthropic pricing docs on the as_of date, not assumed):
The two cache-write rates are NOT the same. Claude Code uses both TTLs in
the same session, so pricing cache_creation_input_tokens at a single rate
These are first-party Anthropic API list rates. If the sessions were run
under a Claude subscription plan, the resulting dollar figures are
'equivalent API cost', not money actually billed. Say so when publishing.

claude-opus-5.note: 1M context is the default and the maximum; no long-context premium.

claude-sonnet-5.note: Introductory rate, in effect through 2026-08-31. Standard rate is 3.00 / 15.00 (cache_read 0.30, write_5m 3.75, write_1h 6.00). All sessions analysed on the as_of date fall inside the introductory window.

<synthetic>.note: Claude Code writes locally-generated assistant lines with model '<synthetic>' and an all-zero usage block. Priced at zero so they never contribute cost, and counted separately so turn counts stay honest.

aliases._comment: Model strings that appear in transcripts but resolve to a priced entry above. A [1m] suffix is a context-window selection, not a separate price tier.
